2609.05094.title: ProCA: Progressive Contrastive Alignment for Robust EEG Visual Decoding
2609.05094.paper_summary: Electroencephalogram (EEG) visual decoding aims to recover visual semantics from non-invasive neural time-series signals, for which robust alignment between noisy neural responses and stable semantic representations is key to achieving high-performance decoding. Despite recent advances in contrastive learning, robust EEG decoding remains challenging because existing methods rely on fixed visual or textual anchors whose semantic relations may become misaligned with EEG representations that vary across trials, subjects, and learning stages. Our empirical evidence shows that this instability appears across both standard EEG decoding protocols and more challenging robustness settings, including strict cross-subject transfer and realistic personalized continual adaptation. We provide a formal analysis showing that fixed semantic supervision can bias optimization when EEG-specific relations evolve, and that structure-agnostic perturbations may distort semantically important EEG components. To address these issues, we propose Progressive Contrastive Alignment (ProCA), a unified and model-agnostic framework for adaptive neural-semantic alignment. ProCA progressively refines class-level contrastive supervision from frozen vision-language priors to EEG-aware semantic relations, and introduces structure-consistent interpolation to constrain feature mixing according to channel-wise and temporal importance. Across subject-dependent, subject-independent, strict cross-subject transfer, and continual adaptation settings, ProCA achieves average relative Top-1/Top-5 gains of 7.4%/3.9%, 10.0%/4.6%, 28.1%/17.8%, and 16.8%/11.6%, respectively.
2609.05094.paper_summary_zh: 電生理圖（EEG）視覺解碼旨在從非侵入性神經時間序列信號中恢復視覺語義，其中噪聲神經反應與穩定語義表徵之間的穩健對齊是實現高性能解碼的關鍵。儘管對比學習最近取得了進展，但穩健的EEG解碼仍然具有挑戰性，因為現有方法依賴於固定的視覺或文本錨點，其語義關係可能與在不同試驗、受試者和學習階段中變化的EEG表徵不對齊。我們的實證證據顯示，這種不穩定性出現在標準EEG解碼協議和更具挑戰性的穩健性設置中，包括嚴格的跨受試者轉移和現實的個性化持續適應。我們提供了一個正式分析，顯示固定語義監督在EEG特定關係演變時可能會偏向優化，且結構無關的擾動可能會扭曲語義上重要的EEG組件。為了解決這些問題，我們提出了漸進對比對齊（ProCA），這是一個統一且模型無關的自適應神經語義對齊框架。ProCA逐步從凍結的視覺-語言先驗中精煉類別級對比監督到EEG感知的語義關係，並引入結構一致的插值，以根據通道和時間的重要性來約束特徵混合。在依賴受試者、獨立受試者、嚴格跨受試者轉移和持續適應的設置中，ProCA分別實現了平均相對Top-1/Top-5增益7.4%/3.9%、10.0%/4.6%、28.1%/17.8%和16.8%/11.6%。
